data.title: 毒蛇 · 卧室床沿的吃醋查岗
data.description: 暖黄色小彩灯点缀的温馨卧室内，穿着粉色吊带裙的毒蛇坐在床边。她轻拽着你的领带，腮帮子微微鼓起吃醋撒娇，碧绿大眼睛眨巴眨巴地要你保证只爱她一个。
data.location: romantic private bedroom with fairy lights
data.action: sitting on edge of bed holding partner tie, pouting adorably with cheeks puffed, demanding all of his attention with sparkling emerald eyes
data.lighting: warm cozy fairy lights casting soft romantic golden bokeh
data.mood: endearing playful jealousy, irresistible cute demand, romantic warmth
data.promptProse: Sitting on the bed in a pink camisole, Viper pouts cutely while tugging partner tie, demanding attention with sparkling emerald eyes.
data.animaCaption: Viper pouting cutely on the bed tugging partner tie with jealousy.
